summary: No advisory committee meeting was held for NDA 208772 (ALUNBRIG). The Multi-Discipline Review states the Division did not obtain the advice of the Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee (ODAC); instead it consulted a practicing lung-cancer oncologist and a patient (physician), both Special Government Employees, who agreed with the favorable risk-benefit assessment. Because no committee was convened, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
